description:
[Game reference] USD exchange rates the site prices with. The live rates every rust.wiki currency switcher converts USD prices through, for the currencies the
switcher offers. Each row carries `code` (ISO 4217), `name`, `symbol`, `flag` (ISO country code), `rate`
(units of that currency per 1 USD) and `inverse` (USD per unit). Sourced from open.er-api.com and refreshed
about every 15 minutes; USD itself is included at 1.0.
name: get_currency_rates
title: USD exchange rates the site prices with
